name: ci
description: Run a configured CI check for the current repository. Use action 'list' to see available checks, then 'run' with a check name to execute one. Only checks explicitly configured in $SHAI_HOME/ci.json can be run.

action.description: Action to perform: 'list' shows available checks for the current repo, 'run' executes a specific check.

check.description: Name of the check to run (required when action is 'run'). Must match a key in the repo's checks config.
